HomePage.hero text: Twilight is a development competition where creativity, technology, and problem-solving come together. Participants turn their concepts into functional projects and compete by showcasing what they can create from a single topic.
HomePage.hero text2: Competitors receive a unique topic and transform it into their own digital creation using websites, games, and any other technologies they choose.
HomePage.text1: Sign up for Twilight (obviously) before October 16th
HomePage.text2: On October 18th the theme will be released
HomePage.text3: You'll have 2 weeks to make something interesting. The only restriction is the theme and the only limit is your imagination
HomePage.text4: Every day you have to upload a screenshot with the current progress of the project or check the box that no progress was made
HomePage.text5: You submit your project as a zip file or a link to github along with the story card before November 1st 10pm
HomePage.text6: On November 2nd you'll present your projects and we'll choose the winner
HomePage.fewrules: There are just a few rules
HomePage.rule1: Teams can't consist of more than 3 people
HomePage.rule2: Any use of AI must be stated
HomePage.rule3: Don't try to lie about anything
HomePage.violationtext: The violation of any rule will lead to disqualification
HomePage.storycardtext: A story card is just a form you'll fill out when submitting your project. It includes the name of your project, your names, a short description, and what you used to build it. And most importantly it includes the story of how you're project came to life, hence the name. Also you can pass some notes to us through it.
HomePage.participateheading: What do we get for participating?
HomePage.winningheading: What do we get if we win?
HomePage.participatetext: Every participant will get a certificate signed by the head of department. But also you gain experience, get to show your skill, and maybe gain new connections. And most importantly you surely will have a lot of fun when it's time to submit the project but nothing is working. ◝(ᵔᗜᵔ)◜
HomePage.winningtext: You also get a certificate, but this time for wining. Recognition from fellow students and the jury. Also we have a special prize prepared for you by our beloved head of department. But that's a secret for now. (•ᴗ-)
HomePage.isitfreetext: Yes, it's completely free. Our goal is to give you a chance to show off your incredible skills. And you'll get a prize if you win.
HomePage.faqheading1: Do we make a website or a game?
HomePage.faqtext1: You can make anything as long as it involves writing code. You can make a website, a game, a console app. But it has to suit the theme.
HomePage.faqtext2: Just sign up clicking the button on the top. Fill out your name and email. Please don't forget the password you'll need it later.
HomePage.faqheading3: How can we participate as a team?
HomePage.faqtext3: All of you have to sign up. Then one of you will add the team members in the dashboard, when doing that fill out the exact full name your teammate has entered while signing up.
HomePage.faqtext4: A jury formed from the teachers of our department will listen to your presentations on Nov 1st and at the end of the event choose 3 winners. The jury also will take into account your Story Card and the source code of your project.
HomePage.questionpart: Be sure to ask any other questions
HomePage.faqtext5: The topic will be released on Oct 18th. We'll choose a theme to give you as much freedom as possible, while also making it a bit challenging and fun. So don't expect it to be something like fantasy or landing.
HomePage.faqtext6: We don't restrict the use of AI. But, as stated in the rules, it must be stated in your Story Card. If you try to hide it, you will be disqualified.
HomePage.faqheading7: How do we present our project?
HomePage.faqtext7: You submit the source code of your project on Nov 1st. The next day you will get about 5 minutes to tell us about your project and show how it works. It is highly encouraged to practice your presentation, because a bad presentation can ruin even the best project.
HomePage.faqheading8: How complex must our project be?
HomePage.faqtext8: Just don't make a single HTML file (╥ᴗ╥). Other than that any project you can make.
